axes: e = metres east, n = metres north of origin

origin.name: Main St (US 322) & State St (PA 272) intersection, downtown Ephrata

transform: worldX = originX + scale*(e*cos(rot) - n*sin(rot)); worldZ = originZ + scale*(e*sin(rot) + n*cos(rot)) — verify CS2 north (+Z) with get_camera/get_city_map before building

note: Zone rectangles are frontage strips along each built segment, district sampled from the 2019 zoning map (georeferenced to OSM). Approximate, not parcel-exact.

RHD.note: small apartments; CS2 high-density towers would be out of character

CBD.note: mixed-use; use Commercial Low on Main St frontage if Mixed is locked

HCD.note: highway strip / big box; Commercial High allowed but towers are out of character

LIC.note: light industry; Office Low is an acceptable substitute

LPD.note: linear park (Ephrata Rail Trail) – leave unzoned
